value.rationale: The natural two-point collinear-versus-opposite dichotomy identifies a precise, finite-variable logical boundary within every odd-order symplectic/dual pair. Individually colouring an entire line still cannot separate geometries, whereas two opposite points suffice by round four; this is a structural insight combining a universal blind equitable quotient and a classical geometric center invariant in a new precise comparison. The formulas apply uniformly over an unbounded prime-power family and any thick GQ in the collinear case. The claim does not depend on a cosmetic normalization or an unmotivated finite table.
